IdentityRegistry.isVerified relies on isClaimValid, so a revoked KYC claim still counts as valid and the wallet can keep receiving tokens.","steps":"1) Setup: wallet b is KYC-verified under idB. 2) Issuer admin calls claimIssuer.revokeClaim(claimId, idB) (the setup's _revokeClaim helper does this). 3) Holder a1 calls token.transfer(b, amount). isVerified(b) still returns true, so the transfer succeeds."}]}
